name: Global Intelligence for Amazon GuardDuty
description: Amazon GuardDuty is a threat detection service that continuously monitors for malicious activity and unauthorized behavior to protect your AWS accounts and workloads. Global Intelligence for Amazon GuardDuty analyzes GuardDuty threats from the Sumo Logic population to create baselines of threats.  These baselines enable you to optimize security posture and remediation based on how unusual your GuardDuty findings are compared to Sumo Logic customers. The App includes preconfigured dashboards and searches with visual displays for global threat baselines and real-time threat detection across your AWS environment.

panels.name: Threat Percent: ALL Threats
panels.queryString:
benchmarkcat guardduty 
| where threatpurpose!="eps" 
| parse field=threatname "*.*" as name, variant nodrop 
| fields -_some_matched
| percentage * 100 as percentage 
| sum(percentage) by threatpurpose, threatname 
| transpose row threatpurpose column threatname

panels.name: Threat Share: Targeted Resource Type
panels.queryString:
benchmarkcat guardduty 
| where threatpurpose!="eps" 
| parse field=threatname "*.*" as name, variant nodrop 
| fields -_some_matched
| percentage * 100 as percentage
| sum(percentage) by resource
| round(_sum)

panels.name: Threat Share: Severity
panels.queryString:
benchmarkcat guardduty 
| where threatpurpose!="eps" 
| parse field=threatname "*.*" as name, variant nodrop 
| fields -_some_matched
| percentage * 100 as percentage
| if (severity="2", "2 - Low", if(severity="5", "5 - Medium", "8 - High")) as severity
| sum(percentage) by severity 
| sort -severity
| round(_sum)

children.name: GI GuardDuty - 02. Your Company v. Baseline
children.description: GI GuardDuty: Your Company v. Global Baseline dashboard compares your AWS environment against all Sumo Logic customers. The threat score (0=LOW RISK, 100=HIGH RISK) is a composite view of risk associated with GuardDuty findings and is impacted by severity, number of findings, deviation from global baseline and rarity of threats within Sumo Logic customers. In addition to the latest score, the trend line panel shows the 7 day trend of the threat score. My Prioritized Action Plan lists the change management actions in order of impact on GuardDuty security posture.

panels.name: 0=Low; 100=High Risk
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/GuardDuty*
| json "accountId", "arn", "type","service.detectorId","service.action","severity","title","description","region" nodrop
| toInt(severity) as severity
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as threatpurpose,resource,threatname
| json field=%service.action "networkConnectionAction.remoteIpDetails.ipAddressV4","networkConnectionAction.localPortDetails.port" as ip, localPort nodrop
| count by resource, threatname, severity
| infer _category=guardduty _model=score
| (100.0 - (round(score * 10000) / 100)) as score

panels.name: 7 Day Threat Score Trend
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/GuardDuty*
| json "accountId", "arn", "type","service.detectorId","service.action","severity","title","description","region" nodrop
| json "type", "severity"
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as threatpurpose, resource, threatname
| toInt(severity) as severity
| count by resource, threatname, severity
| infer _category=guardduty _model=trendline n=7
| (100.0 - (round(score * 10000) / 100)) as score

// Convert to time chart
| _timestamp as _timeslice
| fields - _timestamp
| max(score) as score by _timeslice
| sort by _timeslice asc

panels.name: My Company v. Global Threat Mix   (%)
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/GuardDuty*
| json "accountId", "arn", "type","severity","title","description","region" nodrop
| toInt(severity) as severity
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as threatPurpose,resourcetype,threatName
| count by threatPurpose, threatName, resourcetype, severity
| total _count as totalevents 
| _count/totalevents as my_company_percentage
| benchmark percentage as global_percent from guardduty on threatpurpose=threatPurpose, threatname=threatName, severity=severity, resource=resourcetype
| sum(my_company_percentage) as my_company, sum(global_percent) as global_baseline by ThreatPurpose 
| my_company * 100 as my_company
| global_baseline * 100 as global_baseline
| sort my_company
| fields ThreatPurpose, my_company, global_baseline

panels.name: My Prioritized Action Plan
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/GuardDuty*
| json "type", "region", "severity", "service.action.networkConnectionAction.remoteIpDetails.country.countryName" as type, region, severity, countryname nodrop
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as threatpurpose, resource, threatname
| parse regex field=threatname "(?<threatfamily>[^.!]*)(?:!(?<ta1>[^.]*))?(?:\.(?<threatvariant>[^!]*))?(?:!(?<ta2>.*))?"
| if(isNull(ta1), "", ta1) as ta1
| if(isNull(ta2), "", ta2) as ta2
| if(isNull(threatvariant), "", threatvariant) as threatvariant
| if(isNull(countryname), "Unknown", countryName) as countryname
| concat(ta1, ta2) as threatartifact
| toInt(severity) as severity
| count by region, countryname, threatpurpose, resource, threatname, threatfamily, threatvariant, threatartifact, severity
| infer _category=GuardDuty _model=rankedfinding
| resource as resourcetype
| sum(priorityscore) as score_impact, sum(_count) as _count by threatpurpose, threatname, severity, resourcetype,  region, countryname
| total score_impact as _total | (score_impact / _total) as score_impact
| top 10 threatpurpose, threatname, severity, _count, resourcetype, region by score_impact

// IMPORTANT: Ensure source category in the URL encoder below matches top level source category

| urlencode(format("type  severity title description accountId resourceType region|json field=_raw \"id\",\"type\",\"severity\",\"title\",\"description\",\"accountId\",\"resource.resourceType\",\"region\"|parse field=type \"*:*/*\" as threatPurpose, targetResource, threatName | where (threatPurpose=\"%s\" AND targetResource=\"%s\" AND severity=\"%s\" AND threatName=\"%s\")", threatpurpose, resourcetype ,severity,threatname)) as search_query
| format ("https://service%ssumologic.com/ui/#/search/@-24h@%s",{{RegionCode}}, search_query) as search_query_link
| tourl(search_query_link,"Click Here") as link_to_findings
| fields - search_query, search_query_link | sort by score_impact
 

   
| benchmark percentage as global_percentage from guardduty on threatPurpose=threatpurpose, threatName=threatname, severity=severity
| if(global_percentage < 0.002, "Rare", "Not rare") as Rarity

// rename
| threatpurpose as %"Threat Purpose"
| threatname as %"Threat Name" 
| resourcetype as %"Resource Type"
| severity as %"Severity"
| _count as %"Findings Count"
| score_impact as %"Rel. Score Impact"
| region as %"Region"
| link_to_findings as %"Link to Findings"
| global_percentage as %"Global Percent"
| fields %"Threat Purpose", %"Threat Name", %"Resource Type", %"Severity", %"Global Percent", Rarity, %"Findings Count", %"Rel. Score Impact", %"Region", %"Link to Findings"

| json field=%service.action "networkConnectionAction.remoteIpDetails.ipAddressV4","networkConnectionAction.localPortDetails.port" as ip, localPort nodrop
| parse "\"vpcId\":\"*\"" as vpcId, "\"subnetId\":\"*\"" as subnetId
| fields -%service.action | fields -%type

| count as threatCount by ThreatPurpose,ThreatName
| total threatCount
| (threatCount / _total) * 100 as percentage
| fields - threatCount, _total
| transpose row ThreatPurpose column ThreatName

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/GuardDuty*
| json "accountId", "arn", "type","service.detectorId","service.action","severity","title","description","region" nodrop
| toInt(severity) as severity

| json "service.action.networkConnectionAction.remoteIpDetails.country.countryName" as countryName nodrop
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as threatpurpose,resourcetype,threatname

| parse "\"vpcId\":\"*\"" as vpcId, "\"subnetId\":\"*\"" as subnetId
| fields -%service.action | fields -%type

| count by threatPurpose, threatName, ResourceType, severity
| benchmark percentage as global_percent from guardduty on threatpurpose=threatPurpose, threatname=threatName, severity=severity, resource=ResourceType
| if(global_percent=0, 0.000001, global_percent) as global_percent

| sum(percentage) by ThreatPurpose,ThreatName

_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/GuardDuty*

| json field=%service.action "networkConnectionAction.remoteIpDetails.ipAddressV4","networkConnectionAction.localPortDetails.port" as ip, localPort nodrop

children.name: Rare Threats in Your Environment

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/GuardDuty*
| json field=_raw "id", "type","severity" ,"title","description", "region"
| json field=_raw "service.action.networkConnectionAction.remoteIpDetails.country.countryName" as countryName
| toint(severity) as severity
| parse field=type "*:*/*" as threatpurpose, resource, threatname
| count by threatpurpose, threatname, resource, severity
| benchmark percentage as global_percent from guardduty on threatpurpose=threatpurpose, threatname=threatname, severity=severity, resource=resource
// A rare event is defined as something where the global percentage is less than 0.002
| where global_percent<.002
| count
